# А. А. Зализняк: архив видеозаписей

> Research-edited archive of 176 public video recordings related to A. A. Zalizniak's work — one page per video (v/001/ … v/176/) with machine-readable catalogs.

## Pages

- [Video archive home](https://gasyoun.github.io/ZalizniakVideo/) — 176 video pages at `v/001/` … `v/176/`, e.g. [v/001](https://gasyoun.github.io/ZalizniakVideo/v/001/)
- [Catalog (JSON, v1)](https://gasyoun.github.io/ZalizniakVideo/data/catalog.json)
- [Catalog (JSON, v2)](https://gasyoun.github.io/ZalizniakVideo/data/catalog.v2.json)

Source: https://github.com/gasyoun/ZalizniakVideo
